Dear [Mrs Mercier](/person/990)
As [Madame Melon](/person/2031) says SHE has not written to you I enclose her note that you may see how the matter stands. I hope she will have a satisfactory answer about the Grand Bienfacteur

Yours truly

C M Yonge
